newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 20.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Commetary says the signing of a memorandum between Chinese and Japanese securities watchdogs early this week indicates the possibility of Chinese firms being listed on overseas markets has been improved.
- With competition becoming more and more fierce in China's securities industry, Shanghai brokerages have hired specialised salesman to help attract investors.
- The People's Bank of China, the central bank, has issued an urgent circular, ordering an immediate ban on depositing public funds through private accounts by some state-run companies.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China's exports of electrical appliances hit $2.75 billion last year, an increase of 18.5 percent against 1995.
- Shanghai will conduct an overall renewal of licences for foreign-funded firms in the city, banning those that have failed to renew their licences for a long time.
